user.title: Set up Cargus
user.description: Sign in to your MyCargus account to have its parcels found for you, sent ones included, or track parcels by their AWB without an account.

account.title: Sign in to MyCargus
account.description: Use the e-mail address and password of your MyCargus account and the phone number linked to it.

data_description.email: The e-mail address you sign in to MyCargus with.
data_description.password: Your MyCargus password. It is stored so the integration can sign in again when its session ends.
data_description.phone: The phone number on your MyCargus account, as shown in the app, for example 07xxxxxxxx.

tracking.title: Track parcels by AWB
tracking.description: Cargus tracking needs no account or postal code — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `cargus.track_parcel` service.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to MyCargus again
reauth_confirm.description: MyCargus no longer accepts the password for {email}. Enter the current one.

error.invalid_auth: MyCargus did not accept this e-mail address and password.
error.invalid_phone: MyCargus did not accept this phone number. Use the number linked to your account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MyCargus. Try again later.

data_description.add: Enter a Cargus AWB (nine or ten digits) to start tracking it. You find it on the shipping confirmation or get it from the sender.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That is not a Cargus AWB: it has nine or ten digits.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a parcel by its Cargus tracking code.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a parcel by its Cargus tracking code.

tracking_code.name: Tracking code
tracking_code.description: The Cargus tracking code to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed

request_refused.title: Cargus is not accepting requests
request_refused.description: Cargus refused the tracking requests, so parcel data can no longer be refreshed. The integration may need an update; check for a new release and report it if none is available. Parcels keep their last known status in the meantime.
